"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { Database, File, Folder, Home, Package, Settings, Shield, ShoppingCart, User, Users, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react"

export type AdminIconKey = "database" | "file" | "folder" | "home" | "package" | "settings" | "shield" | "shopping-cart" | "user" | "users"

export const adminIconRegistry: Readonly<Record<AdminIconKey, LucideIcon>> = Object.freeze({ database: Database, file: File, folder: Folder, home: Home, package: Package, settings: Settings, shield: Shield, "shopping-cart": ShoppingCart, user: User, users: Users })

export function resolveAdminIcon(key: unknown): LucideIcon {
  return typeof key === "string" && Object.hasOwn(adminIconRegistry, key) ? adminIconRegistry[key as AdminIconKey] : adminIconRegistry.database
}

export interface AdminNavigationGroup {
  id: string
  label: string
  items: readonly { key: string; label: string; href: string; icon?: AdminIconKey; hidden?: boolean }[]
}

export function AdminNavigation({ groups }: { groups: readonly AdminNavigationGroup[] }) {
  const [pathname, setPathname] = useState("")
  useEffect(() => setPathname(window.location.pathname), [])
  return <nav aria-label="Admin navigation" className="space-y-5">{groups.map((group) => <section key={group.id} aria-labelledby={`admin-nav-${group.id}`}><h2 id={`admin-nav-${group.id}`} className="mb-2 px-2 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{group.label}</h2><ul className="space-y-1">{group.items.filter((item) => !item.hidden).map((item) => { const Icon = resolveAdminIcon(item.icon); const active = pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`); return <li key={item.key}><a aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined} className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-2 text-sm transition-colors ${active ? "bg-primary/10 font-medium text-primary" : "hover:bg-muted"}`} href={item.href}><Icon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" /><span>{item.label}</span></a></li> })}</ul></section>)}</nav>
}
